data.name: Insurance · Contingency agreement
data.description: The homeowner agrees that you do the work their insurance company approves, for the approved amount, while you help them through the claim. One page, signed.

runs.text: You are filing, or have filed, a claim with your insurance company for damage to the property above. This agreement says what we do for you while your claim is decided, and what happens once it is.

We inspect and document the damage, meet your insurance company's adjuster at the property, and help you through your claim, including asking for anything the adjuster missed. There is no charge for this.

You agree that we will do the work your insurance company approves, for the amount it approves for that work. You pay your deductible and anything you ask us for in writing beyond the approved work; you owe nothing else for the approved work.
If your insurance company denies your claim, this agreement ends and you owe us nothing. We may offer you a separate proposal for the work.
You agree to pay us the insurance payments for the approved work as you receive them, and to tell us about every decision your insurance company makes on your claim.
You may cancel this agreement in writing within three business days of signing it, at no cost. We do not make decisions on your claim for you, and we do not give legal or insurance advice.
